reference.addresses: Rows and columns are counted from 0; addresses are A1 notation ("B2", "A1:C10", "A:C", "3:5"). Reading cells waits for the workbook: put await before the methods marked await. Changes need no await.
reference.intro: A script is JavaScript with an async function main(workbook). It runs apart from the app: it can change the workbook, and nothing else: not your files, your account or the internet. Everything it changes is one step that Undo takes back.
